_comment: Get channel IDs via Discord Developer Mode -> right-click a channel. platform is 'discord' (Slack lands in Phase 4). default_model: 'auto' or any provider id (claude/deepseek/gemini/mistral/qwen/glm). channel_preferences maps channel-ID strings to a provider id.
_providers_comment: OPTIONAL. Omit the whole 'providers' block to keep default behavior (every provider enabled iff its API key is present, on its default backend). When present it OVERRIDES per-provider: 'enabled' (force off), 'backend' (toggle), 'model' (slug override), 'routing_tags' (reserved, not yet wired into routing). A per-backend sub-block (e.g. self_hosted) overrides that backend's base_url/model.

providers._backend_options: deepseek.backend: 'api' (China, default) | 'fireworks' (US/ZDR, shares FIREWORKS_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. mistral.backend: 'api' (EU api.mistral.ai, default) | 'together' (US, TOGETHER_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. gemini.backend: 'developer_api' (default) | 'vertex' (needs GCP ADC + google-cloud-aiplatform).
providers._self_hosted_example: { "enabled": true, "backend": "self_hosted", "self_hosted": { "base_url": "http://localhost:8000/v1", "model": "deepseek-v4-flash" } }  -> billed as 'local' (electricity only, no per-token $).
